---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or an enhancement.
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Description
> What feature would you like? One sentence.

## Motivation
> Why is it needed, and what problem does it solve?

## Expected behavior
> How should it be invoked, and what should it return?

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] e.g. add a `kingdee_xxx` tool callable in mock and live mode
- [ ] …

## Scope (Kingdee layer)
- [ ] Data/service layer (WebAPI)
- [ ] Platform-plugin layer (out of WebAPI scope)

## Kingdee version
> Target tenant/version, and note any version-specific endpoint differences.

## Alternatives
> Any alternatives you considered.

## Additional context
> Screenshots, logs, links.
